size.$description: Sizes of things (not distances between them). Primitives are steps of 0.25rem.

4.$description: Size step 4 (16px at the default root size).

5.$description: Size step 5 (20px at the default root size).

6.$description: Size step 6 (24px at the default root size).

8.$description: Size step 8 (32px at the default root size).

10.$description: Size step 10 (40px at the default root size).

48.$description: Size step 48 (192px at the default root size).

64.$description: Size step 64 (256px at the default root size).

80.$description: Size step 80 (320px at the default root size).

sm.$description: Minimum width of a narrow grid column.

md.$description: Minimum width of a standard grid column.

lg.$description: Minimum width of a wide grid column.

cell.$description: Cell size of the blueprint backdrop grid.
